description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a Medical Exam Preparation Chatbot that implements a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with external services like OpenAI and a vector store to facilitate question-answering based on textbook chapters.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing vector storage and search functionalities for document chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs embedding, search, and generates a context-based answer using OpenAI API.
